descriptionChirho: The cardinal number one hundred, used in compound numerals for counting people, animals, measurements, and monetary values throughout the Hebrew Bible. The two clusters differ only in morphological number — singular/absolute 'a hundred' (eng: a hundred / hundred, spa: cien, hin: सौ, arb: مِائَة, kor: 백, swa: mia moja) versus the dual form 'two hundred' (eng: two hundred, spa: doscientos, hin: दो सौ, arb: مِائتَيْن, kor: 이백, swa: mia mbili). Both are inflections of the same numeral.
